title: Authorization header written to logs on every request
problem: `LogRequests` prints the full `r.Header` map, so every bearer token reaches stdout and the log aggregator.

title: Logging: error wraps drop the cause chain
problem: Every wrap site uses `fmt.Errorf` with `%s` and `err.Error()`, so `Unwrap` returns nil and `errors.Is` stops working.

title: Cart tests assert the value they just set
problem: `TestAddItem` asserts `cart.Items` equals the slice it was built from, so it passes whatever `Add` does.

title: Server setup does too much
problem: `NewServer` reads config, wires routes and starts listeners in one function.
